strings.read:
太陽は、世界中の多くの文化で
生命の象徴と見られてきました。
大地を暖め、雪を溶かし春を呼び、
穀物を育て豊かにする・・・{1a}{0c:2b501000514c}そして、太陽は同時に生と死の象徴
でもあります。朝日は生命の誕生を、
日没は死を象徴するという考え方も
数多くの文化や宗教に見られます。{1a}{0c:527c84}さらに、この太陽の動きを
輪廻転生の象徴と見ていた
文化も少なくありません。
輪廻転生・・・わかりますか?{0c:01fb05}
strings.en:
In many cultures around the world, the
sun has been seen as a symbol of life. It
warms the earth, melts the snow, calls
forth the spring, and makes the grain{1a}grow rich...{1a}{0c:2b501000514c}And the sun is at once a symbol of both
life and death. The idea that the morning
sun stands for birth and the sunset for
death is found in a great many cultures{1a}and religions.{1a}{0c:527c84}What is more, no small number of
cultures saw the sun's course as a
symbol of reincarnation. Reincarnation...
do you know the word?{0c:01fb05}
strings.tl: In many cultures around the world, the sun has been seen as a symbol of life. It warms the earth, melts the snow, calls forth the spring, and makes the grain grow rich... // [1]And the sun is at once a symbol of both life and death. The idea that the morning sun stands for birth and the sunset for death is found in a great many cultures and religions. // [2]What is more, no small number of cultures saw the sun's course as a symbol of reincarnation. Reincarnation... do you know the word?

strings.en:
{0c:526c4c}Reincarnation is a doctrine with a
distinctive view of life and death, one
adopted by many ancient religions.{1a}At its core is the belief that a person
who dies is born again, {0c:52744c}and that one soul
goes on repeating life and death without
end, like a wheel that never stops.{1a}Born in the morning, dying in the
evening... {0c:527c84}The sun, repeating this every
day for all eternity, must have seemed a
most fitting symbol of reincarnation.{0c:fe}

[2]The sun, repeating this every day for all eternity, must have seemed a most fitting symbol of reincarnation.
